name: planegcs
status_note: Vendored, modified and built in-tree as libforge_gcs, an LGPL SHARED library (third_party/freecad-derived/sketch-solver). There is no acquire step. tools/deps/forge_deps.py verify checks the content fingerprint and the include-layer content checks; tools/gates/freecad_derived_lgpl_gate.sh checks the LGPL paperwork, the verbatim upstream hashes and that no Forge target compiles these sources.

acquire.note: Every change to the upstream files is listed, with its date, in third_party/freecad-derived/sketch-solver/MODIFICATIONS.md; the verbatim import is its own commit on the introducing branch.

features.eigen: the real Eigen headers (lock entry eigen), compiled into libforge_gcs only.
features.boost: Boost.Graph + Boost.Math headers only, from the boost port.

smoke_test.description: The library's C ABI test, compiled as C11 against the plain header.
